props.name: overflowEdgeThreshold
props.description: How far from an edge, in px, the content must be scrolled before `data-overflow-*-start`/`-end` appear.

parts.name: ScrollAreaViewport
parts.description: The element that scrolls. Its native scrollbars are hidden (`scrollbar-width: none`); it is focusable while it overflows, so the keyboard can scroll it. The distance to each edge is a CSS variable: `--scroll-area-overflow-x-start`, `-x-end`, `-y-start`, `-y-end`.

parts.name: ScrollAreaContent
parts.description: Wraps the content inside the viewport, at least as wide as the content (`min-width: fit-content`), so horizontal overflow is measured.

parts.name: ScrollAreaScrollbar
parts.description: Pressing the track scrolls so the thumb centres on the pointer; the wheel over it scrolls the viewport. Its thumb's size is `--scroll-area-thumb-height` (vertical) or `--scroll-area-thumb-width` (horizontal).

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep the scrollbar in the DOM while there is nothing to scroll on its axis.

parts.name: ScrollAreaThumb
parts.description: Sized and moved along its scrollbar from the viewport's scroll position; drag it to scroll.

parts.name: ScrollAreaCorner
parts.description: Fills the gap where the two scrollbars meet. Rendered only while both are. Sized from the scrollbars' thickness, also exposed on the root as `--scroll-area-corner-width` and `--scroll-area-corner-height`.
